properties.notes: This brownfield site is the central part of the larger Avenue Strategic Site which is a mixed-use redevelopment to comprise 13.4 ha of residential use providing 469 dwellings, 2.8 ha of commercial land for employment use, 1.8 ha of land for provision of a primary school, 0.4 ha of land for other community use and formal and informal play and recreation space.. The reserved matters approval is the first phase of re-development for 261 dwellings.. http://www.ne-derbyshire.gov.uk/index.php/your-council/document-library/local-plan-2001-2011-supplementary-documents/local-plan-documents-february-2017/1586-housing-sites-appendix-c-1
